ADMINISTRATION
The Administration Department is here to serve you.
ATTORNEY
The Morrison County Attorney's Office serves as the chief prosecutor for all felony, gross misdemeanors, and juvenile offenses committed within Morrison County.
AUDITOR / TREASURER
Discover duties and responsibilities of the Auditor / Treasurer Department.
COMMUNITY CORRECTIONS
Morrison County Community Corrections (MCCC) supervises adults placed on pre-trial, probation and supervised release conditions and juveniles on probation who reside in our county. Community Corrections uses evidence based practices to help people turn their lives around and to return to being productive members of the community. Public safety is the top priority for Morrison County Community Corrections.
HEALTH & HUMAN SERVICES
Visit Health and Human Services to learn more about how to obtain services or utilize programs available to you.
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
The Information Technology (IT) Department provides the county with infrastructure, support, central operations, and security to make the systems work that interface with the employees, partners, and citizens.
LAND SERVICES
Check out information about the Land Services Department which includes Planning and Zoning, Permits, and more.
PUBLIC WORKS
The Morrison County Public Works Department is responsible for the county highway systems, solid waste and recycling, landfill, agricultural inspections, and parks and trails.
RECORDER
The Morrison County Recorder’s Office is responsible for recording, indexing, and maintaining documents relating to real estate. We issue birth, death and marriage records. In addition, our office is a Passport Acceptance facility.
SHERIFF
Discover information about the Morrison County Sheriff's Office and their responsibilities and that of their divisions.
VETERANS SERVICES
We are committed to serving and enhancing the lives of Veterans, Active Duty, National Guard, Reserve Service Members, and their families.
